# Backyard Dynasty Baseball

Public static site for Backyard Dynasty Baseball 2026.

Base URL: https://baseball.stephenmandella.com/

## Agent-Readable Indexes

- Site manifest: https://baseball.stephenmandella.com/data/site_manifest.json
- Update metadata: https://baseball.stephenmandella.com/data/site_updates.json
- Sitemap: https://baseball.stephenmandella.com/sitemap.xml

## Public JSON Data

- Standings: /data/standings.json
- Public Oracle team summaries: /data/oracle_public.json
- Full dynasty rankings table: /data/dynasty_rankings_latest.json
- Player rank trajectories: /data/dynasty_player_trajectories.json
- Team intel source data: /data/league_intelligence.json
- Transactions: /data/transactions.json
- Prospects: /data/prospects.json
- Closers: /data/closers.json
- Rivalries: /data/rivalries.json
- Franchise history: /data/franchises.json
- League rules: /data/rules.json
- Polls: /data/polls.json

## Public Pages

- Hub: /index.html
- Power rankings archive: /power_rankings.html
- Standings: /standings.html
- Team Intel: /team_intel.html
- Roster Depth: /roster_depth.html
- Dynasty Rankings: /dynasty_rankings.html
- Prospects: /prospects.html
- Closers: /closers.html
- Transactions: /transactions.html
- League Rules: /rules.html

## Access Notes

Most pages render client-side from JSON files in /data/. Prefer the JSON endpoints above for programmatic retrieval.

For the dynasty rankings table, use /data/dynasty_rankings_latest.json. Its top-level `rankings` array contains the table rows used by dynasty_rankings.html.
